system.description:
Apply only the Expertise benefit of this known stance.

You have learned to enter a highly defensive stance, becoming more guarded and focused on blocking and absorbing damage.

Your [Unarmed Damage] die becomes a d6.

While in this stance, you gain the Reinforced armor property if you weren’t already benefiting from it. Your Reinforced value is equal to your Taijutsu ability modifier.

If you are wearing armor with a Reinforced property, you increase the armored Reinforced value by +2.

DR granted by the Reinforced property cannot be reduced by hostile effects.

Beginning at 5th level, when you take damage, you can spend your reaction to perform Titan Guard.

Titan Guard. You raise your guard, granting yourself a +2 bonus to your AC and your Reinforced value. This bonus lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

Beginning at 10th level, when you successfully use Titan Guard, you can immediately take the Attack action against the triggering creature, adding your Reinforced value to your [Unarmed Damage], if they are within your reach.
